notes: World's first QPU powered by Topological Core using Majorana Zero Modes. 8 topological qubits. InAs/Al semiconductor-superconductor heterostructure. Designed to scale to 1 million qubits on single chip. Part of DARPA US2QC program. Controversial: no peer-reviewed paper yet; Nature paper by 160+ researchers accompanies press release. New Denmark lab to fabricate Majorana chip cores.
